question.text: REITs were first introduced globally through which US legislation?

answer.text: Cigar Excise Tax Extension Act of 1960
Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform Act of 2010

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook page 277, REITs were first introduced in the United States in 1960-61 through the Cigar Excise Tax Extension Act, giving investors access to diversified income-producing real estate portfolios. The Trap: The Securities Act of 1933 and Investment Company Act of 1940 are familiar US securities statutes but did not create the REIT vehicle. Dodd-Frank (2010) is a post-crisis reform law unrelated to REIT origin. Note: The date "1960-61" and the specific Act name come directly from the workbook; recall both elements together to avoid mixing this up with other US securities legislation.
